issues.on_page: Public Works - Other 9,755.64 (General Fund 7,543.29, Street Fund 2,212.35)
issues.issue: Line 33 'Public Works - Other' is separate from line 32 'Public Works - Streets'; the General Fund part (7,543.29) has no printed function and may be utilities or other public works rather than streets. Defensible, already marked review.
Same judgment call as for the statement line: the General Fund 'Public Works - Other' has no printed function, so streets/highways is an assumption.
